n: 6.3 Cu. Ft. Smart Induction Slide-in Range With Probake Convection® And Air Fry
desc:
Get Powerful, Precision Cooking with Induction

Our uniquely designed induction cooktops offer exceptional power, precision, and responsiveness for fast, efficient, and even cooking. Induction uses electromagnetic energy to directly heat your cookware-and only your cookware-making it 5-10% more energy efficient than radiant electric and about 3 times more efficient than gas.The cooktop remains cooler, making it safer and easier to clean.

Quik Boil or True Simmer

With 3,900 watts of power, our UltraHeat™ element is powerful enough to rapidly boil water and flexible enough to turn down to a true simmer.
